title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.187 - Added `sandbox.credentials` to SDK settings types for configuring credential file and environment variable denial in sandboxed commands ## 0.3.186 - Added `agent_id` field to `can_use_tool` control requests — background agents now forward permission prompts to `canUseTool` instead of auto-denying, and stdin stays open while background tasks are running - Added `ReadMcpResourceDirTool` tool type to SDK schemas — MCP resource directory listing is now a dedicated tool instead of a fallback inside `ReadMcpResourceTool` - Added `rewind_conversation` control request for rewinding a conversation to a previous point with durable resume anchor support ## 0.3.185 - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.185 ## 0.3.184
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
